design: Primary 40-case Pass B was frozen first. A fresh skeptical provider context then coded the 12 locked Deep Anchors against exact frozen S1-S10 without primary verdicts; S1 received an extra anti-metaphor instruction requiring an actual proxy/model/report/metric/description/prediction versus realized state.

independentCoder.interruptionBoundary: A01-A04 were already durably persisted and were not resampled; malformed JSON occurred on the next uncommitted case.

s1CeilingAudit.finding: The independent coder did not break the S1 ceiling even after an explicit anti-metaphor instruction. This raises S1 above a single-coder artifact, but does not make 40/40 a population frequency: the historical trajectory schema itself selects cases with claims/observations/consequences and may make representation-reality separations especially visible. Treat S1 as a strong recurring structural pressure, not as statistically proven universality.

rawIndependentContradictions.coderReason: Short-cable success did not generalize to Atlantic conditions.

polarityAudit.reason: S3 is a normative/falsification-oriented claim that an improvement must survive materially different conditions before general progress is asserted. A historical local-gain→OOD failure is evidence for why S3/F2 is needed, not evidence that S3 itself is false. CONTRADICTS must mean the historical evidence makes the frozen claim itself untenable or requires inverse revision, not merely that a historical actor violated the rule.
polarityAudit.effect: The raw independent output remains unchanged as measurement evidence, but HD2 records zero adjudicated direct contradictions.

findings: Exact coder agreement improved from HD1 55.0% to HD2 66.7%, while coarse applicability agreement fell from HD1 79.2% to HD2 75.8%; therefore the taxonomy is not converging monotonically after one additional epoch.
S1 is unusually stable at 12/12 exact among Deep Anchors and primary 40/40, but this is a ceiling requiring future anti-case sampling, not a convergence score.

S6 remains highly unstable: independent coding maps many infrastructure/experimental complexities to SUPPORTS that primary coding leaves N/A. The exact hypothesis requires comparison against a strong simpler baseline, which most historical narratives do not quantify.
S5 also remains coder-sensitive because physical archives, protocols and standards invite metaphorical mapping to persistent state. Rothamsted is a strong direct case; many other mappings are weaker.

The A02 S3 polarity error shows that verdict semantics themselves need discipline. A violation of an invariant by a historical system often supports the invariant as a guardrail rather than contradicting its truth claim.

No adjudicated direct contradiction is established in HD2. This continues the falsifiability concern; future waves should deliberately include historical cases where a supposed guardrail may be unnecessary or harmful, not merely cases where its absence caused failure.

disposition.doNot: Do not use S1=40/40, exact agreement, or raw CONTRADICTS count as a universal-law score.
disposition.retain: Retain primary coding, raw independent coding and the polarity adjudication as separate evidence layers.
disposition.nextMeasurementPressure: HD3 should include anti-case selection designed to challenge whether S1/S3/S7 are necessary, rather than only winner/failure cases where these distinctions are easy to recover.

worldModelUpdate: A historical taxonomy has at least three independent failure modes: codebook elasticity, scaffold/selection effects, and verdict-polarity ambiguity. Reality recurrence must be separated from classifier behavior and from whether historical actors obeyed the proposed guardrail.
